title: Who taught Guy Kelly trumpet
summary: Joe guesses that Buddy Petit or Dimes may have taught Guy Kelly.

blocks.x: Let's get into a bit about Guy Kelly. You said you saw him around when you were a little kid learning.
Do you remember who taught Guy?

Maybe it was Buddy Petit or Dimes(?), one of them. I just can't remember any guy that really taught trumpet in Baton Rouge. But either one of them would be capable of doing it. But I think Dimes took lessons from...maybe some university. I'm not sure. I think they had some teachers that taught there. But I'm sure he must have learned something from Buddy and...
